title: Development Plan
owner: Founder acting as Delivery / Tech Lead
approver: Founder acting as Product Owner within approved Validation scope

rom.calendarCommitmentReason: Planning range only; Production budget and independent gates are not approved.
rom.formula: calendar weeks = (total person-days / 4 productive person-days per week) * 1.15

budgetAuthority.productionRule: P0–P4 requires a new budget decision after Validation Pilot.
budgetAuthority.expenseAtOrAbove1000000Lak: At least two comparable prices/quotations and a recorded selection reason.
budgetAuthority.personalFundsExcluded: 60m LAK living reserve and 15m LAK personal obligations are outside project authority.

scopeRule: Must-only committed baseline; Should/Later requires approved change control.

currentRoles.independenceRule: Founder-created QA, Security or Legal evidence cannot be Verified by the Founder. The gate remains blocked and the system stays safe/restricted.

done: code review and migration compatibility complete
openInputsBefore1_0: fill QA, Security/Infrastructure, Legal and Accountant/Tax reviewer vacancies
approve a separate Production Build budget and P0 commitment after Validation Pilot
collect and independently verify execution evidence
disclaimer: Only the 6-week Validation Pilot and its 25m LAK ceiling are approved. No launch date, Production Build authority or independent gate approval is created by this baseline.
